rows.area: Expanded names and schema target namespaces

rows.remaining: Chameleon assembly and unrestricted namespace/schema composition.

rows.area: Element declarations and ordered decimal content

rows.remaining: General recursive graphs, arbitrary content and implicit anyType breadth.

rows.implementedBound: Assertions may be absent in admitted schema shapes.
rows.remaining: This does not admit arbitrary schemas without assertions.

rows.implementedBound: Closed local/global attributes, optional/required uses and acyclic attribute groups.

rows.area: Named types, component references and derivation

rows.remaining: General complex derivation, arbitrary extension/restriction combinations and recursive models.

rows.area: Choice, all, nested models and occurrence breadth

rows.implementedBound: String, Boolean, decimal, integer families and date in admitted placements.

rows.implementedBound: Exact integer/decimal lexical/value handling under explicit representation capacities.

rows.implementedBound: No native list/union admission is qualified by these production receipts.
